reasoning.text: Reproducibility is moderate: the spec firmly pins the functional core (N=1024, q=12289, 14-bit, Barrett mu/k) and both impls independently rebuild a verified negacyclic NTT with the round-trip identity, but they diverge on the unspecified primitive root and cannot reconstruct the conflict-free schedule, radix-4 butterfly equations, or pipeline timing — the architectural substance is left open. Fidelity is limited by exactly those gaps: parameters match the paper well, but the system's defining innovations (scalable radix-4 with 33%/20% op savings, ~50% operator-sharing, and the per-cycle conflict-free access) are unimplemented or unverifiable, so the impls capture a generic correct NTT engine rather than the specific CFNTT architecture.

[operation] Forward-transform output index convention (natural vs bit-reversed) given the no-bit-reversal claim
